title: Mara and the Lantern
author: Quentin Kavanagh
blurb: Hazel Nystrom, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, has spent fifteen years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ice breaks on the river.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
